title: Growth selector usability policy
scope: Growth controls only; no growth data changes.

changes.behavior: Narrative dimension options display family counts, e.g. すべて (40), 引用・伝聞 (22).
When dimension=all, growthFamily uses optgroup by dimension.
Narrative family options omit a redundant leading dimension prefix and append stage count, e.g. 松茸の長文を伝える · 17段.
Repopulation retains the previous family if it remains in the filtered list; otherwise it selects the first available family.
同段階で別案 works for narrative mode in L1 and L2. Structural reroll remains L1-only.
同段階で別案 is disabled when no alternate family in the current filter contains the requested stage.

invariants: Narrative family count remains 53 and stage count remains 366.
No family id, display, reading, layer, dimension, quality, or weirdness changes.
L3 still has no narrative families.
Native select elements remain in use.
startGrowthFromCurrent must still be able to select an exact matched family after repopulation.
success_criteria: L2/all shows eight dimension optgroups rather than a flat 40-option list.
Single-dimension family labels do not repeat that dimension.
Each narrative option exposes its stage count.
L2 narrative reroll changes to another eligible family rather than returning immediately.
Structural reroll remains unavailable outside L1.
